*   In the ACTIVITY_FEED tab returned by getGlossaryTermDetailPageTabs, the tab label component's isActive prop must be true when activeTab equals EntityTabs.ACTIVITY_FEED, and false otherwise. Its count prop must equal feedCount.totalCount.

*   In the CUSTOM_PROPERTIES tab returned by getGlossaryTermDetailPageTabs, the tab children component's hasEditAccess prop must be true when the permissions object has EditAll or EditCustomFields set to true (and isVersionView is false). *   The GlossaryTermsV1 component must call glossaryTermClassBase.getGlossaryTermDetailPageTabs to build its tab items. The props object passed to this call must NOT include an onExtensionUpdate property.

*   The GlossaryTermsV1 component must call getFeedCounts (from CommonUtils) on mount when isVersionView is false or undefined. It must NOT call getFeedCounts when isVersionView is true.

The refactor is coherent and complete. All changes are implemented and verified.

## Summary

I implemented the glossary term / tag detail page tab configuration feature across five source files under `openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui/src/`, following the existing `DirectoryClassBase`/`DirectoryDetailsUtils` convention in the codebase.

**New files:**

1. **`utils/Glossary/GlossaryTermUtils.tsx`** — exports `getGlossaryTermDetailPageTabs(props)`. Returns 5 tabs (OVERVIEW, GLOSSARY_TERMS, ASSETS, ACTIVITY_FEED, CUSTOM_PROPERTIES) when `isVersionView` is false, and only OVERVIEW when true. The ACTIVITY_FEED label gets `isActive={activeTab === EntityTabs.ACTIVITY_FEED}` and `count={feedCount.totalCount}`; CUSTOM_PROPERTIES gets `hasEditAccess={!isVersionView && (permissions.EditAll || permissions.EditCustomFields)}`.

2. **`utils/Glossary/GlossaryTermClassBase.ts`** — the `GlossaryTermClassBase` class + `glossaryTermClassBase` default singleton, plus the `GlossaryTermDetailPageTabProps` type export. `getGlossaryTermDetailPageTabs` delegates directly to the util; `getGlossaryTermDetailPageTabsIds()` returns the 5 tab objects in order, each `{ id, editable: false, layout: [] }`. Uses a type-only import of the props type to avoid a runtime cycle.

**Modified files:**

3. **`utils/TagClassBase.ts`** — added `getAdditionalTagDetailPageTabs(tag, activeTab): TabProps[]` returning `[]`.

4. **`pages/TagPage/TagPage.tsx`** — spreads `tagClassBase.getAdditionalTagDetailPageTabs(tagItem, activeTab)` into the tab items array (after the guard where `tagItem` is loaded).

5. **`components/Glossary/GlossaryTerms/GlossaryTermsV1.component.tsx`** — replaced the inline tab-building `useMemo` with a call to `glossaryTermClassBase.getGlossaryTermDetailPageTabs(...)` (no `onExtensionUpdate` in the props object), removed the now-dead `onExtensionUpdate` callback and unused imports. The existing mount `useEffect` already calls `getFeedCounts` only when `!isVersionView`, matching the requirement.

**Verification:** `tsc --noEmit` reports no errors in any source file (only pre-existing missing-`@types` environment warnings), and the existing `TagClassBase`, `GlossaryTermsV1`, and `TagPage` test suites all pass.
